```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'  # every 6 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: sync-ai-connector-docs
      cancel-in-progress: true

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Airbyte repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout airbyte-ai-connectors repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-ai-connectors
          ref: main
          path: airbyte-ai-connectors
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get Octavia bot token
        id: get_token
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_DOMAIN }}
          audience: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_AUDIENCE }}
          scope: repo
          policy: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_POLICY }}

      - name: Sync connector docs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          DEST_DIR="docs/ai-agents/connectors"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          rm -rf "$DEST_DIR"/*
          find airbyte-ai-connectors -type f -name '*.md' -exec cp {} "$DEST_DIR"/ \;
          echo "Connector docs sync complete."

      - name: Create PR
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.get_token.outputs.token }}
          commit-message: "chore: sync AI connector docs"
          title: "chore: sync AI connector docs"
          body: |
            Automated sync of AI connector docs from airbyte-ai-connectors.
            This PR is generated by the `sync-ai-connector-docs.yml` workflow.
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs
          base: main
          create-branch: true
          delete-branch: true
          draft: false
          add-paths: docs/ai-agents/connectors/**
          labels: documentation, auto-merge
```
